whyUseful.title: Why is Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker Essential?
whyUseful.subtitle: Solving long, intimidating links, ad-blocker filtering, and compliance risks.

items.title: Brand Trust
items.desc: Users are far more likely to click a clean link that uses your own domain name (e.g. yourdomain.com/go/product) rather than suspicious third-party URLs.

items.title: SEO Protection
items.desc: Automatically applies rel="nofollow sponsored" attributes to all cloaked links to protect your website from Google ranking penalties.

items.title: Legal Compliance
items.desc: The automated FTC disclosure banner ensures your site is 100% legally compliant with a single click.

items.title: Data Ownership
items.desc: Instead of relying on a merchant's dashboard, you own your click data and can track performance directly in WordPress.

items.title: Revenue Protection [PRO]
items.desc: Broken link monitoring pings target URLs daily and expiry fallbacks ensure you never send traffic to a 404 dead page and lose commissions.

items.title: Bloggers & Content Creators

items.title: Email Marketers

items.title: Global Affiliate Arbitrage

userGuide.title: Step-by-Step User Installation & Setup Guide
userGuide.subtitle: Complete 4-phase walkthrough to install, configure links, enable auto-linking, and activate legal FTC compliance.

steps: Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
Click Upload Plugin at the top of the screen.
Select the smart-affiliate-link-cloaker.zip file and click Install Now.
Click Activate Plugin (Enter your License Key when prompted if using PRO).
In your WordPress sidebar, look for the new SALC Links menu and click Add New Link.
Title: Give your link a recognizable name (e.g. 'Amazon - Blue Yeti Mic').
Cloaked Slug: Enter what you want the URL to look like (e.g. blue-yeti).
Destination URL: Paste your actual, long affiliate link here.
Redirect Type: Leave it as 302 (Temporary) for affiliate links.
Click Publish. You can now copy your new, clean URL and share it anywhere!
Go to SALC Links > Settings and click the Auto-Linker [PRO] tab.
Check the box to enable it on Posts and/or Pages.
In the Keyword Mapping table, click Add Keyword.
Type your target keyword (e.g. 'Email Marketing') and select the cloaked link you want to associate it with.
Set a limit (e.g. 1 replacement per post so it doesn't look spammy).
Click Save Settings. The plugin will now link that keyword across your blog posts!
Go to SALC Links > Settings and click the FTC Disclosure tab.
Select your preferred visual style (Default, Alert, Minimal, or Subtle).
Choose where the banner should appear (Top of Content is recommended for strict compliance).
Customize the disclaimer text if desired, and click Save.
